content.name: Niamh Costigan
profile: Product designer who splits the week between an in-house role at a fintech and a small freelance practice. Works end to end from discovery interviews to handover, and prefers shipping a rough thing on Tuesday to a perfect thing next quarter.

education.institution: National College of Art and Design
details: Final year project: a wayfinding system for Dublin Bus interchanges

experience.title: Product Designer
bullets: Sole designer on the merchant onboarding squad, taking sign-up completion from 54% to 71% over four releases.
Built and maintain the component library in Figma that three squads now draw from.
Run fortnightly usability sessions with merchants and write up the findings for the whole product group.
Four days a week; the fifth day is reserved for the freelance practice below by agreement with my manager.

experience.title: Freelance UX Designer
bullets: Discovery and design for small Irish businesses moving a paper or spreadsheet process online.
Recent work includes a booking flow for a physiotherapy clinic and an internal stock tool for an independent bookshop.
Registered for VAT; invoices through my own limited company.

experience.title: UX Designer
bullets: Agency work for public sector and semi-state clients, including a citizen portal redesign that passed an external accessibility audit at the first attempt.
Paired with front-end developers to build the prototypes in HTML and CSS rather than hand over static mockups.

experience.title: Design Intern
bullets: Summer internship in a small print and identity studio during college.
Prepared artwork for press and sat in on client presentations.

additional: Speaker at UX Dublin meetup on designing for low-literacy users
